text:
Mira Patel: Heads up — Harrington FinServ on‑prem rollout scheduled Thu Mar 21 23:00 UTC. Need final signoff for the VPC change window and smoke-check owners.
Simon Grant: I can own the deploy and run the canary. Plan is blue->green with traffic cutover at +10m after smoke.
Lee Chen: I will do preflight at 22:30 UTC: verify certs, BGP, and VIPs. Ping me if infra changes required.
David Ortiz: I'll be standby for rollback and will coordinate with Ops. Rollback plan: restore previous AMI, reapply ansible tag `harrington-20260315`, re-route LB to old target group.
Mira Patel: @Simon Grant can you paste the exact smoke commands we want run so SRE can watch? Also who has bastion creds for Harrington?
Simon Grant: Yep — smoke checklist (short):
1) health endpoints
2) sample inference request (small prompt)
3) KV cache sanity
4) logs for OOMs and model load errors

Commands to run from bastion:
```
# from bastion (jump via jump.hq)
curl -k -H "Authorization: Bearer $HARRINGTON_SMOKE_TOKEN" https://10.3.8.12:8443/v1/ready
curl -k -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://10.3.8.12:8443/v1/generate
./ops/smoke.sh --env=harrington --check=kv,models --timeout=60
```

Lee Chen: Bastion creds are in LastPass under /Shared/Harrington/ops (I updated the note).
Mira Patel: Good. Ops SRE — can you schedule a brief watch from 22:50–00:00 UTC and add alerts for error-rate and model load latency?
Ops SRE: Scheduled. We'll watch:
- service.inference.error_rate > 0.5%
- service.inference.model_load_ms > 2000ms
- host.memory.used_percent > 85%
We'll post metrics in this thread every 5m.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment queued for 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z to Harrington VPC. Runbook ID: HARR-20260321. Notifying oncall.
David Ortiz: Quick note on rollback commands (putting here so it's copy/pasteable):
```
# rollback to previous prod tag
ansible-playbook -i inventories/harrington rollback.yml -e tag=harrington-20260315
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=arn:...:old-target-group
```

Simon Grant: During cutover I'll run a small staged traffic shift: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m pauses. If errors spike, cut back to 0% and trigger rollback.
Mira Patel: Timezone note for the team: 23:00 UTC = 18:00 ET = 07:00 SGT (Fri). Marking that in runbook.
Lee Chen: I'll validate cert SANs and OIDC config at 22:30; will message when done.
Simon Grant: Preflight completed at 22:35 UTC — certs good, VIPs present, BGP routes stable.
deploy-bot: Runbook HARR-20260321: preflight passed, all checks green.
Ops SRE: Watch live starting 22:50 UTC. Posting baseline metrics now.
Mira Patel: Approved from product side. @David Ortiz if rollback is ever needed, call it and I'll coordinate customer comms.
David Ortiz: Got it. I'll be on call and reachable on phone.
Simon Grant: Starting deploy now (23:00 UTC). Will post status updates in-thread.
Simon Grant: Canary 5% in place — initial smoke passed. sample request latency 180ms, no errors.
Lee Chen: Observability looks clean. KV hit-rate normal.
Ops SRE: Metrics stable; error_rate 0.02% (baseline 0.01%). Watching.
Simon Grant: Moving to 25%...
Mira Patel: :thumbsup: ping me when at 100%
Simon Grant: 100% traffic cutover complete at 23:16 UTC. Final smoke run passed.
deploy-bot: Deployment HARR-20260321 completed successfully.
David Ortiz: No rollback needed. Restoring monitoring to normal windows.
Mira Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll send post-deploy note to the customer and close the runbook.
Simon Grant: Leaving notes in the PR and ops runbook with artifact IDs and tags. Good job team.
Lee Chen: Logged post-deploy checks in LastPass runbook.
Mira Patel: Closing thread. If any delayed issues surface, reopen or ping #incidents.
